title: Vesper and the Crown
author: Rafael Underhill
blurb: Rafael Whitlock, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
